title: Atmos extension manifest (extension.json)
description: What an Atmos extension is, what it contributes and what it may use. ATMOS_CORE_INTEGRATION.md, sections 2, 3 and 7.

apiVersion.description: The extension API it targets: 4 for SDK 1.0. Atmos 0.14 and older don't load 4, since they don't read "engines".

publisher.description: Who publishes it ("atmos" is reserved for official extensions).

displayName.description: Its name in Settings, and the default label of its surfaces.

description.description: One line for Settings and the extension manager.

library.description: true for a service that is a library: code other extensions import, with no lifecycle, UI or state.

dependencies.description: Services (bare id) or plugins ("plugin:<id>") it needs, with version ranges.

contributes.description: Its surfaces. Without it, the conventional entry files (panel.js, sidebar.js, settings.js, boot.js) are used.

keys.description: First-party: KeyboardEvent.code values its frame hears anywhere in Atmos.

permissions.description: Everything it uses. Omitted keys mean none.

network.description: Hosts its frames and atmos.fetch() may reach: "api.example.com", "*.example.com" (its subdomains) or "*" (any public host). No scheme, port, path, IP address or local name (.localhost, .local, .lan, .internal, .home.arpa).

browser.description: Browser permissions ("wasm" lets its frames compile WebAssembly).

invokes.description: Other extensions it talks to: "plugin:<id>" or "service:<id>". The system services: "service:audio", "service:wallpaper", "service:location".

node.description: Official extensions only: modules main.cjs requires.

electron.description: Official extensions only: Electron APIs main.cjs uses.

ipc.description: Official extensions only: main.cjs registers IPC handlers or sends events.

resources.description: Official extensions only: atmos-resource:// providers main.cjs registers (for its own frames).

provides.description: Ignored since SDK 1.0 (kept so older packages load).

exports.description: What it shares with other extensions: "official" (official extensions) or "all" (community ones too).

isolation.description: Official extensions: "origin" gives it an origin of its own.

tier.description: Ignored by Atmos (where the extension comes from decides).

requires.description: Before SDK 1.0: Core capabilities it needs. Use "engines" instead.

runtime.description: Ignored since Atmos 0.12 (every extension runs in frames).

legacyStorage.description: First-party: data it kept elsewhere before moving into frames.

contract.description: A service's own API contract (documentation; Atmos doesn't read it).

entry.description: Its entry file, relative to the extension.

icon.description: An SVG file in the extension, drawn in the text colour.

shortcut.description: One printable key that opens it from anywhere in Atmos.

glass.description: Atmos draws frosted glass under the frame where it says (atmos.surface.trackGlass).

drawer.description: First-party: the panel lives in a drawer sliding up from the bottom of the workspace.

legacyId.description: First-party: the id it had before frames.

showIn.description: The panels it shows beside at first ([]: every panel).
